source: Sri Lankan Academic Repository Target Inventory (Data-Collection Project Deliverable)
notes: OAI endpoints for groups B, C, D (DSpace) and SLIIT were inferred from verified DSpace/OJS software identification, not directly harvested at compile time. Confirm each with a live ?verb=Identify request before production use.
For DSpace 6 sites use /oai/request; for DSpace 7/8 (Angular UI) sites use /server/oai/request.
dspace.ac.lk (LEARN/ODRaaS) is a near-empty pilot as of mid-2026 and is deliberately excluded from harvesting; revisit quarterly.

2026-07-19 live validation pass (scripts/validate_repositories.py + manual web-search cross-checks): several sites only serve OAI-PMH over plain http:// (broken/absent HTTPS), one needs a 'www.' host prefix, and jfn_research/jfn_medicine's OAI service lives at the server root rather than under /ujrr or /med. endpoint_verified_live=true entries below were confirmed with a real ?verb=Identify response on that date; see each entry's notes for specifics.

2026-07-19 Week 3 large-scale harvest finding, IMPORTANT for planning: 'endpoint reachable' does not mean 'has harvestable data'. Of the 17 targets with a live OAI-PMH endpoint, only 7 (uom, cmb, seu, sltc, ruh, uwu, sliit) actually returned records via ListRecords/ListIdentifiers; the other 10 responded fine to ?verb=Identify and ?verb=ListMetadataFormats (and in several cases ?verb=ListSets shows real collections with content) but return 'noRecordsMatch' for the actual data query -- almost certainly a stale/unbuilt OAI index on the DSpace side (a known DSpace admin issue: 'dspace oai import' needs to be re-run after certain changes), not a wrong URL or missing content. scripts/validate_repositories.py now checks this directly (has_records field) instead of only checking Identify. This is a real blocker for full national coverage and likely needs direct outreach to those institutions' IT/library staff to ask them to rebuild their OAI index.

repositories.name: UCSC (Colombo School of Computing)
repositories.notes: Site itself is live and browsable at /jspui/ (confirmed via web search and direct fetch), but no OAI path returned a valid response: tried /oai/request, /jspui/oai/request, /dspace-oai/request over both http and https, all HTTP 404. Sitemap fallback also checked 2026-07-19 (sitemap_index.xml / sitemap.xml at both the domain root and /jspui/) -- none found either. This legacy JSPUI instance currently has no automated bulk-metadata access route; would need direct handle/browse-page crawling, or contacting the institution.

repositories.name: University of Peradeniya
repositories.notes: Old instance at dlib.pdn.ac.lk may still hold legacy content. Endpoint inferred; needs re-validation.

repositories.name: University of Kelaniya
repositories.notes: Site is live and indexed publicly (confirmed via web search; http://repository.kln.ac.lk/ serves real content to browsers). But every scripted request we made -- https (SSL handshake fails: TLSV1_UNRECOGNIZED_NAME) and http on /oai/request, /xmlui/oai/request, /jspui/oai/request (all HTTP 403 with a 'NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW' WAF page) -- was blocked. Sitemap fallback also checked 2026-07-19 -- no sitemap_index.xml/sitemap.xml reachable either (same block). Looks like bot/WAF protection covering the whole site, not just OAI. Also hosts Gampaha Wickramarachchi University of Ayurveda as a sub-community (see gwuas entry).

repositories.name: University of Sri Jayewardenepura
repositories.notes: https fails with SSLEOFError (no valid TLS listener); http connection is accepted then reset mid-request ('Remote end closed connection without response') on every retry. Site is documented as live via web search (dr.lib.sjp.ac.lk). Needs retest from a different network/IP before concluding it's actually down.

repositories.name: University of Jaffna (research repository, UJRR)
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19: OAI service lives at the server root (http://repo.lib.jfn.ac.lk/oai/request), NOT under /ujrr (that 404s -- /ujrr is only the XMLUI browse path). https is unreachable (connect timeout); must use http. Also has a community on dspace.ac.lk, but production repository stays on its own domain.

repositories.name: Buddhasravaka Bhiksu University
repositories.notes: Hosted under NSF infrastructure, distinct from dl.nsf.gov.lk itself. Verified 2026-07-19: original guess (/oai/request, DSpace 6-style) was wrong -- it's actually DSpace 7+ and needs /server/oai/request. Its own <baseURL> in the Identify response self-reports as https://repo.busl.ac.lk/server/oai/request (a different canonical domain) -- worth testing that domain directly too. Currently returns noRecordsMatch on ListIdentifiers (empty/stale OAI index, same pattern as several other institutions -- see top-level notes).

repositories.name: University of Ruhuna (IRUOR)
repositories.notes: Confirmed XMLUI DSpace; exact version not read. Endpoint inferred from software.

repositories.name: Eastern University (EUSL e-Repository)
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19. Two fixes vs. the original inference: (1) needs the 'www.' host prefix -- the bare digital.lib.esn.ac.lk does not resolve (DNS NXDOMAIN); (2) must use http, not https (no valid TLS listener). Legacy /rest may possibly be available, unconfirmed.

repositories.name: Sabaragamuwa University
repositories.notes: Note the non-standard :8080 port. Confirmed XMLUI DSpace; exact version not read. 2026-07-19: port 8080 is completely unreachable from this environment (connect timeout on the bare host, before even reaching a path) -- could be an outbound firewall on this network blocking non-standard ports rather than the server being down. Retest from a different network before concluding it's dead.

repositories.name: Wayamba University (WUSL Repo)
repositories.notes: 2026-07-19: unreachable on both https and http (connect timeout on both). Unlike most others in this batch, an http fallback does not fix it -- looks genuinely down or blocked, not just a bad cert. Web search confirms the URL itself is correct (repository.wyb.ac.lk), so retest later or from another network.

repositories.name: Uva Wellassa University (UWU eRepo)
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19: live over https as originally documented; has real data (100 records collected before failure). But a real large-scale harvest (scripts/harvest_all.py) hit a server-side HTTP 500 on the second page, when following the resumptionToken -- the first page (100 records) works, ListRecords with resumptionToken=oai_dc////100 does not. Looks like a bug/misconfiguration in this instance's resumption-token handling, not a client-side issue. Harvesting this fully will need either retry/backoff logic, a smaller page size, or a fix on UWU's end.

repositories.name: University of Vavuniya (DRR)
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19 over http (https unreachable). Legacy /rest may possibly be available, unconfirmed.

repositories.name: Gen. Sir John Kotelawala Defence University (KDU)
repositories.notes: Registered in Jisc SHERPA/Sherpa Services (repository ID 10783, ROR 04n37he08) as a DSpace repository, corroborating status, and the site's homepage does load. But every OAI/REST path attempt failed: https://ir.kdu.ac.lk/server/oai/request -> HTTP 404; http:// on the same path -> HTTP 522 (Cloudflare 'origin connection timed out'). This looks like the actual DSpace backend behind Cloudflare is down or misconfigured, not a wrong URL -- worth a direct check with KDU's library/IT.

repositories.name: National Science Foundation (NSF), Colombo
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19: live over https exactly as documented -- OAI Identify + ListMetadataFormats (13 formats) and REST API both returned 200, robots.txt allows it. This is a clean, ready-to-harvest endpoint. HOWEVER: a real ListRecords/ListIdentifiers harvest returns 'noRecordsMatch' for oai_dc with no filters -- the OAI index currently has zero exposed records, despite earliestDatestamp being recent (2026-05-11), suggesting the instance is new/reindexing rather than actually empty of content. Re-check periodically; this is a data-availability gap, not a reachability problem. High-value aggregator when populated: 'Journals Published in Sri Lanka' and 'Conferences and Workshops of Sri Lanka' communities give broad national coverage in one feed. Deduplicate against SLJOL and institutional feeds.

repositories.name: NSF -- SLJOL journal platform
repositories.notes: 176 journals, 25,506 articles, 2,988 issues (as of July 2026). Richest single journal-article feed for Sri Lanka; covers institutions lacking their own repository (PGIA, PGIS-adjacent, Pali & Buddhist Studies, Buddhist & Pali University). 2026-07-19: every request we made -- including just GET / -- returned HTTP 403 with a bare '403 Forbidden' body, regardless of User-Agent. This is WAF/bot-protection (likely Cloudflare) blocking automated clients outright, not a wrong path.
repositories.action_needed: DELIBERATE DECISION (2026-07-19, Week 3): we will not build any WAF-bypass/anti-bot-evasion logic for this endpoint -- that would mean deliberately circumventing NSF's access controls, which is out of scope regardless of technical feasibility. Path forward is to request official API access or IP allow-listing directly from NSF/SLJOL admins before this source can be harvested. Until that access is granted, SLJOL stays excluded from automated collection; do not retry with spoofed headers, proxies, or headless-browser tricks to work around the 403.

repositories.name: Postgraduate Institute of Medicine (PGIM), Colombo
repositories.notes: Site states 'updated daily'. RSS 1.0/2.0 + Atom feeds at /feed/... Item count not independently confirmed. 2026-07-19: https is unreachable (no TLS listener; connect timeout) -- must use http. Homepage and robots.txt both load fine over http (200), but /oai/request returns HTTP 403 from an Apache Tomcat error page (access denied), tried also at /jspui/oai/request and /dspace-oai/request (both 404). robots.txt reveals the DSpace sitemap config points at an internal IP (192.248.21.144), suggesting a semi-broken/internal-facing config. Looks like OAI harvesting may be restricted server-side rather than just a wrong path -- worth asking PGIM directly, or scraping via the RSS/Atom feeds and handle browsing as a fallback.

repositories.name: SLIIT (Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology)
repositories.notes: 4,309 items on home page (3,600 Articles, 290 Theses; top depositor 'Jayathilaka, R' with 163 items). Verified 2026-07-19: reachable and returns a valid Identify response, but its HTTPS certificate fails validation (SSL cert error). A production harvester will need to either fix trust for this host deliberately (log it, don't silently disable verification globally) or wait for SLIIT to fix their cert.

repositories.name: LEARN shared platform (dspace.ac.lk / ODRaaS)
repositories.notes: Run by Lanka Education and Research Network as 'Open Digital Repository as a Service', backend dspace-b.ac.lk. As of mid-2026 holds only 2 communities (pilot/training) -- not yet a production national aggregator. Do not build a harvester yet; revisit quarterly. If it grows beyond ~5 populated institutional communities, re-evaluate consolidating harvests here.
